question.title: A2 work-coverage boundary
question.introductionMarkdown: Same A2. Actual terminal Evidence exposes implements/verifies/ref bag; requirements relation verbs omit work. No typed work coverage API found in named owners.

items.promptMarkdown: Bind work coverage to separate owned personal-plan/work-edge fixture data plus existing legacy Evidence refs, while implementation/verifies counts remain independently zero; or name an existing typed work-coverage owner to READ?
items.contextMarkdown: EvidenceProvider default artifact adapter maps only implements/verifies and deliberately declines to attribute merged refs. Negative can exercise that real adapter with work refs/personal done and assert exact Missing, distinct from NoEvidence Unavailable. Positive uses existing Evidence snapshot with nonzero implementation/verifies counts and no work item, not a new acceptance evaluator. WRITE unchanged.

options.label: Use existing bounded seam
options.description: Retain work data as explicit untyped/separate observation and exercise actual terminal adapter.

options.label: Name typed coverage owner
options.description: Grant exact existing owner for typed work coverage without new ABI.

recommendation.explanationMarkdown: Named APIs do not expose typed work evidence; preserving that limitation avoids inventing a new runtime contract.

submission.noteMarkdown: First Agent under Owner delegation confirms existing bounded seam. Root inspected actual EvidenceProvider default adapter: typed implementation/verifies counts stay separate; merged refs are deliberately unattributed. Use separate owned temporary personal-plan/work-edge fixture plus legacy refs as explicit untyped coverage observation, not invented typed Work evidence. Missing implementation/verifies Known0 must remain Missing even with workref/personal done; NoEvidence remains Unavailable, distinct. Positive uses actual existing Evidence snapshot/provider API with valid nonzero implementation/verification observations and no work item; describe provider-supplied observation/validity boundary precisely, not a new runtime artifact validator. Do not silently substitute planning/work count for implementation or coerce unavailable to0. Preserve unchanged shared binding/origin/local identity and no owner/current/done scheduler fields. No progress-core/facts WRITE or new schema/evaluator/secondcursor authorized. Record typed work-coverage capability limit in final report; if future integration is needed, Root will backlog it without blocking this characterization.
